posts.text:
Everyone online: OMG Qwen 4 Max is closed source, Chinese open-weight strategy is over.

In reality: It's the same strategy they've had for years. Qwen keeps the strongest model API only and has an abundant open weight strategy below that.

posts.text: Dario's comments on the state of the technology are largely agreeable, as he said "experts largely agree," but he also combined it with forecasts of what comes next, which experts do not agree. Is a persuasive way of talking, he's good at what he does.
